title: Cross-bind signed capabilities matrix to live-coverage.json
summary: The new docs/signed-capabilities-live-coverage.md matrix names live test paths but does not cross-check against the structured scopeCoverage entries in agent-os/autonomy/live-coverage.json. Add a validator extension that requires every delegated-covered or delegated-denial-only row in the matrix to correspond to a delegated:true scopeCoverage entry in live-coverage.json, so the markdown matrix cannot quietly outpace the structured live coverage record.
expectedFailureModes: The markdown matrix marks an action delegated-covered while the structured live-coverage.json scopeCoverage block has no matching delegated entry, hiding the drift.
A future scopeCoverage entry is removed from live-coverage.json without updating the markdown matrix, leaving the matrix overclaiming coverage.
Validator extension is added but does not run in validate.sh --scripts, so drift slips past CI.
nextAction: Extend agent-os/scripts/validate-signed-capabilities-live-coverage.mjs to require each delegated-covered or delegated-denial-only matrix row to map to a delegated:true scopeCoverage entry in agent-os/autonomy/live-coverage.json with the same namespace and live test path.
